spec_title: Uptime alerting — prod health probe with push notification (outages must not wait for manual testing)

items.text: An external probe (GitHub Actions cron, no new infra) runs every ~5 min
An outage is declared only after **N consecutive** failures (default 3,
items.matched_test: all view tabs are visible after selecting a project

items.text: On a down transition a `health.down` alert is emitted; Yuri is notified
On recovery a `health.recovered` notice is emitted with the **downtime
items.matched_test: /${universe}/${UNKNOWN_SLUG} renders the 404 SPA view with recovery links

items.text: Probe never fails the CI job (exit 0 always) so the alert channel cannot
